reason: Both are building-products manufacturers selling roofing and insulation through distributors and contractors. Owens Corning is centered on residential asphalt shingles, fiberglass insulation, and glass-fiber composites and nonwovens. Carlisle is centered on commercial single-ply roofing, polyiso insulation, and waterproofing, plus some aerospace and medical components. The product overlap is real but covers different roofing types and end-market focus, and Owens Corning's composites business has no Carlisle counterpart. That makes them adjacent rather than direct competitors.
